name: Johns Hopkins macromolecular crystallography core: Formulatrix Rock Imager 1000 (NIH S10; 2023)
brief: A macromolecular crystallography core that already has a lipidic-cubic-phase nanolitre liquid handler adds a 500-tray automated crystal tray imager with visible, UV and multi-fluorescence imaging, to monitor crystallization trays and log them in high throughput.

cost.excludes_note: NIH S10 award for the imager alone (equipment funds, possibly with institutional match not stated); the existing Mosquito LCP at the core is not part of the award.

notes: price_basis=configured, set from the source wording (S10 award for an imager "with 500-tray capacity and dual light path ... UV and multi-fluorescence") before base/configured catalog prices were researched. Single-instrument price check with an exact model match; independent of the catalog's Rock Imager price source (NIH 2014 PO). Verified 3 Oct 2026 via NIH RePORTER API (1S10OD034322-01, award_amount 187457). Quote: "This proposal requests funds to purchase a Formulatrix Rock Imager 1000 automated crystal tray imager with 500-tray capacity and dual light path capable of both visible light, ultraviolet (UV) and multi-fluorescence imaging." Single-instrument case: 1 of 1 items (100% by count and value) maps to formulatrix_rock_imager_1000. Useful as a clean price check of one catalog id, with the caveat that the S10 award may differ from the actual invoice (UV/fluorescence options, install, service).
